post.caption:
A processor only understands numbers meaning move this, add that, jump there. Writing that directly is possible and unbearable, so we built assembly above it, then high-level languages above that, with compilers translating downward, and an operating system underneath handing out memory and hardware. Abstraction is the whole trick: every layer exists so the layer above can stop caring about the details. That is how three readable lines move billions of switches.
